description: This file defines the TalkModeController class, which manages the state and behavior of the talk mode feature in the application. It handles enabling/disabling talk mode, updating phases and levels, pausing/resuming, and stopping speech, interfacing with related controllers and shared runtime components.

classes.name: TalkModeController
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the talk mode state, interactions, and UI updates within the application.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode asynchronously, updating UI overlays and notifying runtime components accordingly.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current talk mode phase and communicates the change to the gateway connection.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the voice level indicator in the UI overlay.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the talk mode, updating relevant components and the gateway.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of the talk mode.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Instructs the runtime to stop speaking, with a specified reason.

methods.name: exitTalkMode
methods.description: Disables talk mode via the application state store.
